alerts.headline: The SEVERE CYCLONIC STORM AKVAN with maximum wind speed of 90-100 gusting to 110 Kmph lays centred at 1130 IST of 18.11.26 near latitude 13.1N and longitude 85.4E, 540 Km southeast of Narsapur, Andhra Pradesh. Cyclone Warning for Alluri Sitharama Raju, Anakapalli, Srikakulam, Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram.
alerts.description: The Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan [Pronunciation: Akvan] over central parts of South and adjoining Westcentral Bay of Bengal moved north-northwestwards with the speed of 08 kmph during past 06 hours and lay centered at 1130 hours IST of today, the 18th November, 2026 over the westcentral and adjoining central parts of south Bay of Bengal, near Latitude 13.1N and Longitude 85.4E, about 540 km southeast of Narsapur (Andhra Pradesh), 570 km east of Chennai (Tamil Nadu), 600 km south-southeast of Kalingapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), 690 km south of Gopalpur (Odisha) and 750 km south of Puri (Odisha).  Co
areas: Alluri Sitharama Raju, Anakapalli, Srikakulam, Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram districts of Andhra Pradesh
